scope: Offline exact-board USB-to-eMMC source review and local fixture tests; no live execution by reviewer
verified_code_guards: Targetpartitions mmcblk0p1/p2 and source sda1/sda2; formatter targets open pinned descriptors
Own old eMMC RO/noload backup and fingerprint-sealed job/CM5/CID manifest BEFORE sfdisk; recheck before hook
Hook exacttrustedmount directory, no symlinkancestors, findmnt device+UUID, root runningUSB; fixedhash and sealedbackup reread before anywrite
Own machine-id and exactownSSHhostkeyset; donor root/userSSHprivatekeys removed; ownkeys restored and approved benchpubkey onlytechaid
Detectorconfig preserved byte-for-byte; network UUID/MAC/BSSID pins reset, BMI30 peerSTA removed, homeSTA DHCP and password retained
Own AP identity/address and workingband/channel retained; stale credential stores removed for service regeneration
Donorrollbackguard and portable-adoptunits/dropins removed; only activefeature172055 portable marker
Root criticalverification/fstab/fsync before kernel-last bootactivation; finally+ExecStopPost ownershipsafe recovery
launch_requirements: Plan bench_public_key must contain reviewed operator PUBLIC key before launch
Plan personalizer_sha256 must equal this report; recovery_bundle_version must be2026-11-03-172055
No live start is performed by these tests; source and new eMMC must be checked after actual boot
postboot_checks: Verify hostname/CM5/eMMCroot+boot IDs, own SSHhostkey and credentials access
Verify APssid/subnet and actualBSSID differs from S07/donor; clearing UUID alone is not runtimeproof
Verify source USB remains unchanged and full detectorconfig values/types match; Core mode/worker/network readiness
No STM firmware writes or physical detection/35cm performance claims
